name: LOTUSim
description: An open-source, real-time maritime simulator for human-in-the-loop robotics research, supporting multi-user interaction across aerial, surface, and underwater robotic systems for coordinated naval-style operations.

name: LOTUSim-Energy
description: A real-time maritime simulator for multi-domain human-drone interaction in offshore wind energy operation and maintenance, unifying heterogeneous unmanned vehicles within a distributed architecture for autonomous inspection and fault detection.

name: AI Trust and Safety
description: Research on trustworthy and safe AI systems, including the informational quality and reliability of AI-assisted content in the written press.

name: RoboCup
description: IRL CROSSING's participation in the RoboCup@Home competition through the RoboBreizh team, focused on fully embedded social and service robotics.
